summary: Kinross Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing its Q2 2026 earnings release date of July 29, 2026, and a conference call/webcast for July 30, 2026. This is a routine earnings announcement with no disclosure of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or a forced management change. The filing is a standard periodic reporting obligation.
